segments.name: Aviation management companies
segments.pitch: End to end foreign VAT reclaim on fuel, handling, parking and other costs paid abroad.
segments.pain: Aircraft operate across many countries, so VAT is paid abroad on many invoices and rarely reclaimed.

segments.name: Transport operators
segments.pitch: End to end foreign VAT reclaim on fuel, tolls and other road costs paid in other countries.
segments.pain: Fuel and road costs paid abroad carry VAT that stays unclaimed and erodes margins.

segments.name: Hotels
segments.pitch: End to end foreign VAT reclaim on supplier invoices and cross-border costs.
segments.pain: Complex invoices from foreign suppliers hide VAT that could be recovered.

segments.name: Hotel groups
segments.pitch: End to end foreign VAT reclaim across all properties, handled centrally.
segments.pain: Many properties and suppliers across countries make foreign VAT hard to track and claim.

notes: Good fit: companies that regularly pay for goods and services in other countries and have a finance contact. Deal breakers: no cross-border costs, tiny sole traders, VAT advisory competitors.
